verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only indirect ways to act on many items at once. Metadata cascade policies and metadata queries (box-docs-38) can apply or find data across a folder's contents. Mounting a Box folder as a synced POSIX filesystem (box-docs-28) would let an agent script operations over many files. No dedicated batch or bulk API is documented. missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk operations endpoint (e.g. bulk move/copy/delete/tag), documentation of bulk limits and behavior, MCP or CLI bulk tooling evidence, hands-on or independent corroboration.
